title.zh: 到期后由指定 lock 解锁
title.en: Unlock by a given lock after a time

inputs.label: input
inputs.body: Cell{ lock: { codeHash: TIME_LOCK, args: {{lock_hash 32B}} ‖ {{locked_until 8B}} } }, since ≥ locked_until

role.zh: 所需 lock 脚本哈希

cons.zh: 每个 group 输入 since 不小于它
cons.en: no group input since below it

cond.zh: 输入中有 lock hash = args[0..32]
cond.en: an input has lock hash = args[0..32]

cond.zh: 每个 group 输入 since 不小于 locked_until；ckb-std 比较时标志字节不同即不可比较，视为通过（按源码推断）
cond.en: every group input since is not below locked_until; with different flag bytes ckb-std cannot compare and it passes (inferred from source)

notes.zh: 错误码（error.rs）：1 IndexOutOfBound · 2 ItemMissing · 3 LengthNotEnough · 4 Encoding · 5 InvalidArguments · 6 LockTimeNotPassed · 7 RequiredLockScriptNotFound
notes.en: Error codes (error.rs): 1 IndexOutOfBound · 2 ItemMissing · 3 LengthNotEnough · 4 Encoding · 5 InvalidArguments · 6 LockTimeNotPassed · 7 RequiredLockScriptNotFound

notes.zh: 不检查任何签名：安全性完全来自 args 指向的其他脚本
notes.en: No signature is checked: security comes entirely from the script that args points to
